transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the routine morning logistics huddle. I need same-day changes from each of your lanes before I publish the final water-dispatch order. We have 5,400 gallons of potable water available today, which gives us two tanker loads of up to 2,700 gallons each. The four receiving sites are North Post, the clinic, the maintenance workshop, and Observation Site East, with a standard request of 1,200 gallons per site and any remaining water held as battalion reserve. Please report any changes affecting your lanes — water point, medical, motor transport, and engineering. Who wants to start?

This closure notice has not yet been added to the route overlay, so the dispatch order should account for the detour and revised timing for the workshop delivery.
